step1_analysis.description: The paper describes a source-coupled logic (SCL) frequency divider. However, the provided extracted netlist is malformed with most terminals shorted to a single node (N0) and no active pull-up path, making it non-functional as a divider.

paper_reference.title: Phase Noise in Digital Frequency Dividers

sky130_expected.calculation: In the provided malformed netlist, XM4 is fully ON (Vgs=1.8V) and pulls N0 to GND. Other transistors are mostly shorted. Since XM5/XM6 have D=S=N0 and G=GND, B=VDD, they don't conduct DC channel current from VDD to GND. Thus, DC power from VDD will be dominated by reverse-biased junction leakage (N-well to P-sub).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the broken netlist topology where no direct DC path from VDD to GND exists.

max_operating_frequency.description: Maximum clock frequency the divider can correctly divide

sky130_expected.calculation: For a functional SCL divider in 130nm, max frequency is typically >5GHz. For this broken netlist, it will not divide at all.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Netlist is non-functional and outputs a static 0V.

phase_noise.description: Phase noise floor of the divider

sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected for a typical divider, but cannot be simulated here.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the provided netlist. Applies a 3GHz clock to N1 and measures power and transient response on N0.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Frequency Divider Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

XM1 N0 N0 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N0 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 VDD GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 GND N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 GND N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 N0 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 N0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N0 N0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VCLK N1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 10p 10p 156p 333p)

.control
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  tran 1p 2n
  meas tran v_max max v(N0)
  meas tran v_min min v(N0)
  let swing = v_max - v_min
  print swing
  quit
.endc
.end
